dict.string: Private Workout Logger reads your most recent bodyweight to estimate workout calories on-device. It is never uploaded or shared.
Private Workout Logger can save each finished workout to Apple Health as a strength training session. Only the workout and its times are written — never an estimated calorie value.

Photograph a written or printed workout sheet so Private Workout Logger can read the sets for you to review. The photo is processed on-device and never leaves your phone. Logging works without the camera.
Import a photo of a workout sheet so Private Workout Logger can read the sets for you to review. Images are processed on-device and never leave your phone.
